title: Third Person Point of View — Omniscient, Subjective, and External
skills: distinguish among major forms of third-person narration
identify how much access a narrator has to characters' thoughts
analyze how narrative distance affects reader understanding
choose an appropriate third-person perspective for narrative writing
alignment_note: Compares omniscient, subjective, and external forms of third-person point of view. Supports narrative analysis, point-of-view identification, understanding of narrative distance and information control, and intentional perspective choices across high school English and creative writing courses.
